title: Online campaign limit
summary: Each account can now host up to 2 online campaigns at a time. Joining other campaigns as a player and playing on your device stay unlimited.
items: Start a room and My account show how many online campaigns you host, for example "1 of 2 online campaigns".
At the limit, close or delete one of your online campaigns to free a slot, or keep playing that campaign offline on your device.
Nothing you already host is closed or removed, and account backups do not count toward the limit.
